> Do not paste real camper, leader or parent details into an issue. Describe the shape of the problem or use obviously fake data.

## Background

What prompted this, and why it matters. Link related issues, ADRs or specs.

## Scope

What this issue covers, as concretely as you can (which files, components or workflows change).

## Out of scope

Anything adjacent that is deliberately *not* part of this issue.

## Acceptance criteria

How we will know this is done, as testable statements where possible.

## Depends on

Any issues this is blocked by. Also record each one as a GitHub "blocked by" relationship (see Issue conventions in CLAUDE.md); say here why, and list anything that is not an issue (a person, a device, a decision).
